{{Top|leg}}
'''Lord Superior''' was a title used by the leader of the [[Unified Factions]], the government of the planet [[Kroctar]] and of the [[Kroctari]] people. [[Bosmihi]], the leader who negotiated a treaty of alliance with the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], was a holder of the title.
